data.text: Owner's Complementary settings are below its POTATO profile (SHADOW_QUALITY=-1 = program.world0/shadow.enabled=false, no shadow pass; SSAO/reflections/lightshafts off, CLOUD_QUALITY=1) - main reason Toon felt heavier. Mac pack v4: SUN_SHADOWS option (default on, Toon Lighting page); off -> program.shadow / world1/shadow / world-1/shadow .enabled=false (Iris keys root programs without folder prefix) and sunShadowFar returns skylight proxy at all distances, sunShadow returns 1.0. Untested in-game when written.
